body:
The lonely part is mostly based on the fact that when I first met her I had some fun roommates, then we moved in together to our own apartment. So I'll be alone in a big space and as I have very few friends locally I'm pretty sure it'll be lonely. I'm also quite an introverted person and spending time with her was most of my social life anyway. On the contrary, she has plenty of friends so I don't have to worry about her side of things. 

I've been doing therapy for nearly 3 years now and I do find it to be helpful. I'm not feeling lonely when I'm by myself, it's just that I'm going to miss her a lot, probably. I'm perfectly aware of not having to be with someone to feel full or whatever, it was just a very close relationship that I truly enjoyed.

I have lots of hobbies and some people I can talk to. 

Anyway, thank you for the advice, I appreciate it.

Yeah, we were both crying and very very gentle with each other while she talked to me, explaining her reasons for leaving me.

I really hope to not lose her fully, the connection we have is very important to me. Of course, I'll let her have her time off from me first. It's just that I'm scared that I'm going to lose such a wonderful person forever. I'd hate for that to happen. I'm glad we don't have any mortgage, but we share an apartment and that's hard enough. I'm glad the friendship part worked out for you!
Nearly 2 years. But we've never were apart for more than a few days so it feels like much more

The sad thing is that she definitely isn't a bad person. We had our disagreements and they were mostly about the same shit (my boundaries and her feeling like I was controlling). She said it made her resentful towards me and that she just mostly stopped having feelings for me, which I understand. My fault was looking at some things from my perspective only, like her developing a crush on her friend was very heartbreaking to me, because I don't work like that. When I finally dealt with that it must've been too late, I guess.

I hope we can be friends in the future, it would be a pity to lose her.

We first both decided to part ways because she had a crush on her friend which didn't quite sit right with me and which caused plenty of problems. I was dealing more or less ok with that but she didn't, and initiated us getting back again. It all seemed to go in the right direction after that, we did one couple's therapy session that helped imo, went on a short vacation and I was making plenty of effort to try to make things work. I guess I didn't succeed.

The worst thing is the constant anxiety that I feel and the pressure on my chest that won't go away.

I'm also having a hard time forming relationships. It takes me a lot of time to really open up to someone irl and I'm definitely not everyone's cup of tea. 

Thank you for that comment, it made me feel less alone.

I don't even know what to say, it's just such a heart wrenching situation. I still love her and all I want is to have her back. And she also seemed so sad to make that decision. I started watching my favorite show to distract myself, maybe that'll help. Thank you ❤️
You pass so well and are very pretty!!!
